title: JEPA world-state and action simulator
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for action-conditioned latent world-state prediction, representation-space epistemic energy anomaly gating and counterfactual multi-step rollout planning.
boundaries: ActionConditionedStatePredictor projects observations into factored latent representations (leases, resource quotas, record digests, capability taints and invariant predicates) and flags invariant breaches before irreversible execution.
EpistemicEnergyAnomalyGate computes representation-space surprise E(s_hat, s_obs) invariant to surface formatting jitter and triggers rollback or review whenever surprise exceeds grid bounds.
CounterfactualRolloutPlanner ranks candidate multi-step trajectories strictly inside representation space without executing external side effects.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for action-conditioned latent world-state prediction, representation-space epistemic energy anomaly gating and counterfactual multi-step rollout planning

value.lets_workers: Encode environment observations into compact factored latent world states (leases, resource quotas, record digests, capability taints and invariant predicates), predict post-action states s_hat_{t+1} = transition(s_t, a_t) before irreversible execution, gate unexpected execution divergence via representation-space epistemic energy E(s_hat_{t+1}, s_obs_{t+1}) and rank K multi-step counterfactual rollouts by goal distance plus cumulative risk energy.

flow.when: Simulate K candidate multi-step action sequences in representation space before irreversible execution and rank feasible trajectories by goal distance plus cumulative risk energy.
Compare predicted post-action world state s_hat_{t+1} against observed world state s_obs_{t+1} in representation space and trigger review or rollback when surprise exceeds grid bounds.
Independently verify pre-execution invariant rejection, surface-jitter invariance, anomaly rollback recall and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Multi-step counterfactual rollout and post-action surprise evaluation bundle recomputed in test_world_state_jepa.py: rejects unfenced/tainted commit plans pre-execution, selects plan-fenced-sanitized-clean (goal_distance_energy 0.0, total_objective_energy 0.3925), assigns 0.0 surprise energy under benign whitespace/timestamp jitter and triggers rollback on 100% (3/3) of injected lease-theft, phantom-CAS and quota-drain anomalies (max energy 9.18778).

nouns.title: Guardrail: irreversible or state-mutating actions must pass factored world-state transition simulation before execution
nouns.category_reason: Blocks unfenced writes, capability taint leaks, compare-and-set version conflicts and quota exhaustion prior to execution.

value.rule: Reject any candidate trajectory whose predicted post-action state violates lease_fenced, quota_non_negative, taint_isolated or cas_version_monotonic invariants.
value.how_it_is_checked: ActionConditionedStatePredictor.predict_transition and CounterfactualRolloutPlanner.rank_candidates mark invariant-breaking trajectories infeasible before recommending any plan.

nouns.title: Guardrail: epistemic surprise thresholds and rollout horizons resolve from NodeGrid with zero inline magic scalars
nouns.category_reason: Keeps rollback thresholds tunable and enforces mechanical AST conformance across simulator modules.

value.rule: Resolve review_energy_threshold, rollback_energy_threshold, max_rollout_horizon and risk_energy_weight from default_grid_spec.json and enforce ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
value.how_it_is_checked: scan_directory_for_hardcoded_values and NodeGrid constraint tests run during make check.

nouns.title: Specification: ActionConditionedStatePredictor, EpistemicEnergyAnomalyGate and CounterfactualRolloutPlanner invariants
nouns.category_reason: Defines factored representation components, post-action energy decomposition and multi-step rollout objective.

nouns.title: Deterministic factored latent transition, epistemic surprise energy and rollout ranking rules
nouns.category_reason: Zero-model representation-space transition and anomaly energy equations.

value.surprise_energy_equation: E(s_hat, s_obs) = w_q * ||q_hat - q_obs||_2^2 + w_l * d_lease + w_d * d_digest + w_t * |taints_obs \ taints_hat| + w_inv * broken_invariants + w_lat * ||z_hat - z_obs||_2^2
value.rollout_objective: J(a_{0:H-1}) = E_goal(s_hat_H, g) + lambda_risk * sum_{t=0}^{H-1} R(s_t, a_t, s_hat_{t+1})

value.name: JEPA world-state and action simulator
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Implements ActionConditionedStatePredictor encoding raw observations into surface-noise-invariant FactoredWorldState embeddings and predicting post-action transitions.
Implements EpistemicEnergyAnomalyGate computing representation-space surprise E(s_hat_{t+1}, s_obs_{t+1}) and gating execution into continue, require_review or trigger_rollback.
Implements CounterfactualRolloutPlanner simulating K multi-step trajectories and ranking feasible minimum-energy plans.
does_not: Execute external side effects, reconstruct raw pixel/token noise or embed hardcoded numeric scalars in operational functions.

value.shows: Counterfactual world-state rollout ranking, surface-jitter invariance and representation-space anomaly rollback detection.

value.shows: Recomputes trajectory ranking (rejecting unfenced tainted commits), 0.0 surprise under benign whitespace/timestamp jitter and 1.0 rollback recall across injected state anomalies.

verbs.title: Simulate K candidate multi-step action sequences in representation space and rank feasible plans

slots.name: rollout_bundle
slots.description: Pin of initial observation, target goal state and K candidate action sequences.

steps: Encode raw environment observations into FactoredWorldState embeddings discarding surface timestamp and formatting noise.
Simulate each candidate sequence through ActionConditionedStatePredictor and sort feasible plans ahead of invariant-violating plans by goal distance plus risk energy.

acceptance.check: Trajectories that violate lease fencing, capability taint isolation, CAS monotonicity or non-negative quotas are marked infeasible and never recommended.

verbs.title: Evaluate post-action representation-space surprise energy and trigger review or rollback on divergence
verbs.summary: Compute factored and latent epistemic energy E(s_hat_{t+1}, s_obs_{t+1}) between predicted and observed post-action world states and gate execution against grid review and rollback thresholds.
verbs.outcome: Epistemic surprise energy breakdown and continue, require_review or trigger_rollback gate verdict.

slots.name: step_observation_bundle
slots.description: Pin of executed action and observed post-action environment states.

steps: Predict post-action world state s_hat_{t+1} and encode observed state s_obs_{t+1} into the shared representation space.
Evaluate weighted quota, lease, digest, taint, invariant and latent L2 surprise energy against grid thresholds.

acceptance.check: Benign surface formatting jitter produces zero surprise energy while stolen leases, phantom CAS mutations and unpredicted taints trigger rollback.

verbs.title: Independently verify counterfactual rollout ranking, anomaly rollback recall and AST magic-literal gates
